body.statement: Characterize the set of \((\alpha,\beta,\gamma,d)\) for which \(\rho_\star(n)\asymp r_{\mathrm{or}}(n)\), and on its complement derive the exact nuisance-limited exponent with any boundary logarithm. The characterization must distinguish \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) separately whenever two laws with the same sum \(\alpha+\beta\) have different testing difficulty. On each phase, compare minimax-detectable sequences in \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\) with Yu's learner condition \(\mathsf Y_n\) only on laws satisfying \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{Yu},n}(P)\); at \(V(P)\asymp r_n^2\), record separately Yu's root-\(n\) signal requirement \(\sqrt n\,r_n^2\to\infty\). Compare the same sequences with Dhawan--Guo--Shah only on the intersection satisfying \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}\). For DGS, use the DGS score-translation lemma: at \(V(P)\asymp r_n^2\), Corollary 2 additionally requires \(\operatorname{Corr}_P(s_P(U),\xi_P(U)\mid\widehat h_n)>\kappa_n\) with high probability and \(n\kappa_n^2r_n^2\to\infty\). Establish every claimed strict inclusion or non-inclusion by legal sequences in \(\mathcal P^{\mathrm{obs}}\), using a dense orthogonal bump pack against the hunted direction and a one-direction aligned alternative as the comparison handle; if either construction fails the full-law lift or a published applicability condition, report that relation as unresolved rather than asserting it. Separate uniform omnibus power from favorable-direction pointwise power.
body.justification: The phase map must distinguish statistical hardness from the sufficient learner and alignment conditions imposed by currently implementable first-order procedures.
body.gap: Yu2026VarianceHTE, Assumption 4 and Theorem 1 require separate learner remainders and additional boundary nondegeneracy, while DhawanGuoShah2026, Corollary 2 applies to its projected score on \(U\) under \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}\), conditional correlation above \(\kappa_n\), and \(n\kappa_n^2V_{\mathrm{DGS}}(P)\to\infty\); neither paper locates these sufficient regimes relative to the Hölder minimax radius or proves a class inclusion.
body.consumer: The resulting verified relation map tells users of the Yu variance test and \(\texttt{dScoreTest}\) when their guarantees reach the omnibus frontier, when favorable alignment yields different pointwise power, and when corrected energy is required.

obligation.what_is_open: The exact minimax phase map, any dependence on \(\alpha\) and \(\beta\) separately, and the requested strict inclusion or non-inclusion relations for the Yu and Dhawan--Guo--Shah applicability classes.
obligation.obstruction: These conclusions depend on the unresolved observational converse. In addition, a Hölder bump pack can be chosen orthogonal to one fixed direction, but the hunted direction is training-sample random and the published regularity predicates include conditions not implied by membership in the frozen model class. Assuming them uniformly would silently strengthen the experiment.
obligation.attempted: The achieved upper-envelope threshold was derived algebraically, the DGS score and energy were translated exactly, and the extra DGS correlation and signal conditions were separated from overlap. No sequence was certified to satisfy the full published applicability predicates while also establishing the requested strict class relation.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved upper endpoint equals the oracle benchmark exactly when
\[
 \alpha+\beta\ge\frac{2d\gamma}{4\gamma+d},
\]
and otherwise has nuisance exponent
\[
 \frac{4\gamma(\alpha+\beta)}{4\gamma(\alpha+\beta)+d(\alpha+\beta)+2d\gamma}.
\]
This is a characterization of the achieved bracket, not of the unknown minimax frontier.  On any sequence with \(V(P_n)\asymp r_n^2\), the cited Dhawan--Guo--Shah implication additionally needs its regularity predicate, the conditional correlation event, and \(n\kappa_n^2r_n^2\to\infty\).  Its projection calculation supplies no uniform lower bound on that correlation.  Yu's guarantee likewise remains restricted to laws satisfying both \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{Yu},n}\) and \(\mathsf Y_n\), and its separate signal requirement is \(\sqrt n\,r_n^2\to\infty\).
In the proved oracle-optimal region this last signal expression is
\[
 \sqrt n\,r_{\mathrm{or}}(n)^2
 =n^{1/2-4\gamma/(4\gamma+d)},
\]
so it diverges exactly when \(\gamma<d/4\), is constant at \(\gamma=d/4\), and vanishes when \(\gamma>d/4\).  At the achieved nuisance endpoint it diverges exactly when
\[
 d(\alpha+\beta)+2d\gamma>12\gamma(\alpha+\beta),
\]
with equality giving a constant order.  These calculations concern Yu's separate root-\(n\) signal requirement and do not establish \(\mathsf Y_n\).  Without the sharp \(r_n\) and without a verified bump construction preserving the published applicability predicates, no strict class inclusion is proved.
